short_description: HIV-1 rebuilt as a gene-delivery shuttle — almost the entire viral genome removed, the packaging genes split across separate producer-cell plasmids, leaving a VSV-G-pseudotyped envelope and the conical Gag capsid to deliver a therapeutic cargo gene (flanked by self-inactivating LTRs) that reverse transcriptase and integrase write into the target cell's genome. Replication-incompetent: it cannot make more of itself.

reference.attribution: CDC/ Dr. A. Harrison; Dr. P. Feorino, 1989
reference.note: This is an HIV-1 plate (mature free virions), not a lentiviral-vector-specific image — no freely-licensed vector-specific micrograph exists. Disclosed in the caption per the chlamydia-felis precedent.
